title: Agentii User Config (~/.agentii/config.json)
description: Schema for the per-user agentii config file (FR-053a, FR-043c, FR-006a). Lives at ~/.agentii/config.json on POSIX; file perms 0600, directory 0700.

install_uuid.description: Auto-generated on first install, persisted, never re-generated. Used as a stable anonymous identifier in telemetry events.

server_export.description: If true, events are exported to agentii.ai backend. Default false (local-only).

failure_traces.description: Capture failure tracebacks locally (not exported unless server_export=true).

usage_metrics.description: Count skill invocations and MCP tool calls locally.

office_binding.description: Binding resolution for office plane. plugin-mcp = FR-043a, cowork-office-js = FR-043b, user-mcp = FR-043c.

offline_mode.description: When true, skills refuse MCP calls and surface a user-facing error explaining offline-mode limitations (FR-043c).

x402_wallet_address.description: FR-006a forward-compat reserved key. Silently ignored in v1.0 (SC-019c). Do NOT validate format; future version will enforce.

agentmail_inbox_id.description: FR-006a forward-compat reserved key. Silently ignored in v1.0 (SC-019c).
